notes.title: Progress update 2
notes.notes:
The cruise ship level is mostly done, with the required quests in place, so I've moved on to working on the next section of the game. These are still incomplete and don't have any actual gameplay elements set up so far, but I'm making steady progress with the maps themselves. On top of these I still need a couple more to complete chapter 2. Like I've said before, these take a lot longer than the Cruelty Squad levels because of the amount of stuff I have to consider, all the writing I have to do, and it doesn't make sense to just release one new area because some of the quests require you to navigate multiple ones. I know this makes up for a frustrating update schedule but it should be worth it in the end.

I've also done some optimization on the existing levels by adding occlusion culling, among other things.

Here's some screenshots.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44804922/3ee3ab40f032f29b4c51c56df9800c7835e21078.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44804922/402e050497cfe0a6fdd82479afa1c132af0fc589.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44804922/c52b52b2ada6da2662ca05cd8a56ace776505257.png"]

notes.title: Progress update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone. I'm still working, it'll take a while before I have anything ready for release since a lot of these things are quite complicated and take a while to get to any playable state, especially with all the writing involved. Basically all of my work time is just going to level design and writing dialogue and quests. I've mostly finished setting up the beginning of the next major case, which was easy since it didn't require any new npcs or areas. I'm not going to spoil too much of it but here's a rough screenshot from the level editor of the next major area. It'll be a sort of throwback to the Seaside Shock level from Cruelty Squad but with more stuff going on. It should be a fun change of pace from the earlier levels.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44804922/31fc401e9eec7f60a9217248b04fd5cc655609de.png"]

My goals for the next update are the following:

Gambling

Chapter 2 playable to completion. This is the thing that will take the most time as I will need to create at least three new areas minimum, two of them quite complex.

Some more side quests.

Drawing the missing portraits.

Adding more stuff to Y-net. I've already done some of this.

Adding more dialogue for existing underdeveloped NPCs.

Writing descriptions for more weapons, parts etc.

Balancing and fleshing out the skill system. Possibly adding an actual XP system so you don't have to use money to level up, making it more useful.

Giving different enemy types etc. a different amount of money depending on how dangerous they are. Possibly rare item drops for specific enemies.

Here's some other stuff I may or may not work on before updating:

Doing something with the death screen "alignment" panel, and reworking the calculations for it. This will probably be later game stuff, beyond chapter 2, so it's not a huge priority, but I'd like to get started on it.

Working on some of the under construction areas like the forest in countryside and the catacombs underneath Necropolis. These are side areas that can be completed whenever so I might postpone this until later unless I feel inspired to work on them specifically.

Experimenting a bit with the damage calculation system.

Possibly an additional easy mode where all unique NPCs are tracked by default. This could be toggled in the settings. Could also be an equippable you can purchase, though I feel the people who would use this probably won't find the shop either before rage quitting.



That's all I can think of right now. Thanks for your patience.

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Here's the small update I promised. Whatever I have planned next will take more time as it requires making new levels etc.

New side quest, needs to be fleshed out a bit.

On foot loadout weight should work a bit better, making light weapons and equipment a bit more viable. If you go over the limit you won't be able to jump.

The adaptive camo now increases your toxicity level during use, it's also disabled when you fire.

New weapon, new helmet, new body armor.

notes.title: Small update again
notes.notes:
I was going to start using the beta build but the budget screen was busted and I wanted to get that fixed in the default build so here we are again.


The budget screen should now have correct values for dividends. (I was only multiplying the amount owned by the dividend percentage before, when I should have also been multiplying by the stock value.)
Changed mech aiming a bit. I think it's better now but I might bring the old style back as an option in the settings, as this is probably going to be divisive.
Added bullet time effect to cocaine. The effect is stronger with bigger doses.
Some new dialogue for a couple of characters, but nothing particularly important.
Specialist class now starts with an orgone energy active camo suit. Uses orgone energy to make you nearly invisible for a short period of time. Not available for other classes right now but it will be later, you also need to start a new game because I'm not currently dealing with class changes properly, this will be fixed later.
Added orgone shield mechanics for mechs. It's currently only available with one of the armor units. Hasn't been balanced or tested much and needs more sfx and vfx.


Also a funny anecdote, someone was telling me that the difficulty levels don't work and posted a video of them fighting Lorenzo outside of HQ with all the different difficulty levels. If you don't know, Lorenzo is supposed to be impossible to kill here, and his purpose is to push you back to HQ to accept the main quest. The "time to kill" in this case is always going to be the same. If you want to test the difficulty levels please pick a different enemy.

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Small update just to get back on track. After this one I will begin using the beta build, which you will be able to opt in to. This is just to get some pressure off potentially messing things up, I want the default build to be at least somewhat stable. I will let you know once it's live here.


Updated Godot to 3.6. Seems to work fine but I didn't have time to test everything yet. If it breaks everything it doesn't matter that much since there's like 5 players playing at any given time.
Added some new dialogue for Bion.
New parts, SEEB Booster-M and GHI STAR.
A better grappling hook item, well hidden and a bit OP, this will probably be moved to a different place later but I thought it would be fun to have for now until I get around to adding more options.
Added a budget screen where you can see your daily income and what it consists of.
Shooting in EFP HQ no longer generates ammo debt.
Enemy mech aiming speed is a bit slower.
The car outside the gym is now a prop so you don't end up aggroing the whole gym by shooting it.
If you shoot someone without being seen it doesn't aggro the entire faction anymore. For example if you kill Konrad in his office you can walk out and nobody will care.

notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes:
If you go to the title screen from a loaded save the game now actually resets all the data when you start a new game.
Reset aim (default binding Q) now consistently centers the aim of the V-Stalker

notes.title: Minor patch
notes.notes:
Added new V-Stalker legs with slightly different boost mechanics. Can be found somewhere in the world.
Fixed money duplication glitch involving bribing civilians.
Settings now save when the game autosaves. Save settings button is still there and you should still press it after you're done changing your settings, just in case.

notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes:
Hey everyone. I still have the flu but I couldn't entirely keep myself away from working. I focused on easy to fix issues.


Replaced reference to Ohio with a reference to Michigan. This was due to skibidi rizzoid zoomers thinking it was a meme of some sort. You can't let these people win.
Added EFP Standard Cyanide item. Useful in case you get stuck.
Added a fallback option for completing the Memory is Precious quest.
Some items now get new stock every day at the HQ shop.
Fixed mystery enemy in necropolis having way too loud audio, and activating when it wasn't meant to.
Fixed airsoft pistol occasionally crashing due to not having a valid ammo type.
Fixed spawning inside the seafloor when moving from Harbor to Bridge of the Sovereign.
Fixed infinite sleeping exploit.
Fixed dying from poison while in the V-Stalker softlocking the game.
Fixed being able to repeatedly buy and sell from a single NPC to drain all their money.
Fixed rappel creating infinite visual duplicates if it was recast before colliding with something.
Fixed falling through the elevator if you go unconscious while it moves.
Attempted a fix for the windows display scaling issue. (Can't really test this very well)
Attempted to fix the high pitched noise when walking. (This doesn't affect me so I can only guess what causes it)

notes.title: Minor patch 2
notes.notes:
Small patch. Unless I manage to turn all enemies into fleshrats by introducing inverted Y axis I will now take a small break, due to having the flu.


Added option to invert mouse Y axis.
Added option to limit FPS
Fixed a money exploit.
Menu frontend should now more accurately represent actual settings after booting the game.


If you're having problems with the resolution and text size, you should try disabling Windows UI scaling for this game.
